## About
Japanese & European Used Auto is a used auto parts store on Palm River Rd in Tampa. People call us looking for a specific part, and we do our best to track it down for them.
We're open weekdays, and the easiest way to start is a phone call. Our customers have given us a 4.1 rating from 196 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Used auto parts: Call and ask about the part you need. We'll let you know if we have it.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We're closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I call ahead to see if you have a part?
A: Yes. Give us a call and ask about the part you're looking for before you head over.
